identity.notes: Active anime/cyberpunk PFP project. Historical avatar-development evidence is not treated as proof of an exhaustive shipped VRM set; the keyed inventory pass must resolve actual files.

evidence.note: Current official 0N1 Force link hub exposes the project Discord/community destinations.
Announcement identifies https://discord.gg/0n1-force as the official Discord.
DappRadar records 0N1 Force launch date as Aug 19, 2021.
Official project history independently states the collection minted in August 2021.

ip_rights.summary: Current 0N1 Force terms grant the NFT holder a worldwide royalty-free personal license and an unlimited worldwide commercial license to use the purchased art to create derivative works, while project/company rights and project-wide usage remain separately reserved by the issuer.

evidence.note: Terms revised Dec 3, 2023; sections ii-iii define personal and unlimited commercial/derivative holder usage.

project_status.note: Current official website/link hub and active project surfaces remain live; no sunset announcement was found in the current official sources checked.
